nodes.name: analytics.ts
nodes.summary: Provides daily KPI snapshot computation and dashboard analytics for the ERP, aggregating order revenue, inventory counts, pick metrics, and MSA compliance status into time-series snapshots.

nodes.name: rollupDaySnapshot
nodes.summary: Aggregates order and SKU data for a given UTC day into a persistent KPI snapshot record.

nodes.name: dashboardKpis
nodes.summary: Computes high-level dashboard KPIs by assembling today vs prior day order metrics, pick performance, and MSA status.

nodes.name: upsertSnapshot
nodes.summary: Validates and upserts an externally-provided daily KPI snapshot record, enforcing role-based access.

nodes.name: ap-bills.ts
nodes.summary: Handles accounts-payable vendor bill lifecycle including three-way match validation (PO, receipt, bill), bill creation from purchase orders, and payment recording with GL journal posting.

nodes.name: computeThreeWayMatch
nodes.summary: Performs three-way match validation comparing PO quantities, received quantities, and bill amounts to detect discrepancies.

nodes.name: runThreeWayMatch
nodes.summary: Loads bill and PO from database, runs three-way match computation, and persists match results to the vendor bill record.

nodes.name: createBillFromPurchaseOrder
nodes.summary: Creates or updates a vendor bill from a purchase order, computing landed cost allocations, posting PO receipt GL journal, and triggering three-way match.

nodes.name: recordBillPayment
nodes.summary: Records a partial or full payment against a vendor bill, updates balance and status, and posts the AP payment GL journal.

nodes.name: audit-log.ts
nodes.summary: Provides lightweight audit event creation and retrieval, writing structured action records with entity context to the database for compliance and traceability.

nodes.name: auditLog
nodes.summary: Creates a structured audit event record in the database with action, entity type, entity ID, user ID, and optional metadata.

nodes.name: backorders.ts
nodes.summary: Manages backorder lifecycle: reserves available stock across FEFO lot allocations, creates backorder lines for unmet demand, and fills open backorders when new stock arrives.

nodes.name: reserveLineWithBackorder
nodes.summary: Reserves as much stock as available across FEFO lot allocations and creates a backorder line for any unmet quantity, updating the order line item accordingly.

nodes.name: fillBackordersOnReceipt
nodes.summary: When new stock is received for a SKU/warehouse, fills pending backorder lines in order priority and triggers fulfillment tasks for newly satisfied orders.

nodes.name: bank-recon.ts
nodes.summary: Provides bank reconciliation capabilities: managing bank accounts, importing bank statement lines, matching unreconciled lines, and producing reconciliation summaries.

nodes.name: importStatementLines
nodes.summary: Validates the bank account exists and bulk-inserts bank statement lines within a transaction for later reconciliation.

nodes.name: reconcileStatementLine
nodes.summary: Marks a bank statement line as reconciled and updates the bank account's cleared balance within a database transaction.

nodes.name: barcode-labels.ts
nodes.summary: Generates printable barcode label HTML for a given SKU, supporting configurable quantity and using Code128-style barcode formatting.

nodes.name: billing.ts
nodes.summary: Manages Stripe-based subscription billing: creating checkout and portal sessions, applying plan changes from webhook events, and syncing plan status to the tenant and auth databases.

nodes.name: createCheckoutSession
nodes.summary: Creates a Stripe checkout session for a tenant upgrading to a paid plan, configuring success/cancel URLs and ensuring a Stripe customer exists.

nodes.name: handleBillingWebhookEvent
nodes.summary: Handles Stripe webhook events for subscription lifecycle changes, applying or downgrading tenant plans based on subscription status.

nodes.name: bin-locations.ts
nodes.summary: Provides CRUD operations for warehouse bin locations, supporting zone and aisle metadata used by WMS putaway and pick tasks.

nodes.name: buyer-context.ts
nodes.summary: Resolves buyer identity context from a session, distinguishing portal buyers from admin staff and providing helper functions to enforce buyer-scoped access and retrieve auth profiles.

nodes.name: compose.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the Celestial AI response composition module, verifying formatting of tool results and fallback reply generation.

nodes.name: compose.ts
nodes.summary: Composes AI assistant replies from structured tool execution results, formatting warehouses, orders, invoices, quotes, low-stock alerts, and catalog results into Markdown, with doc-based fallback replies.

nodes.name: composeFromToolResults
nodes.summary: Filters tool results that contain data and maps them through section formatters to build a unified Markdown reply.

nodes.name: buildDocFallbackReply
nodes.summary: Constructs a fallback Markdown reply from platform documentation chunks when tool results are empty, filtering technical docs for consumer-facing responses.

nodes.name: conversations.ts
nodes.summary: Manages Celestial AI chat conversation persistence: creating or retrieving conversations, appending messages, listing conversation history, and updating timestamps.

nodes.name: intent.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the Celestial AI intent detection module, verifying classification of user messages into tool selection intents.

nodes.name: intent.ts
nodes.summary: Pure intent detection module for the Celestial AI assistant — classifies natural-language messages into sets of ERP tool names using regex patterns for orders, invoices, inventory, quotes, and search.

nodes.name: detectIntent
nodes.summary: Classifies a user message into a set of ERP tool names by matching regex patterns for orders, invoices, quotes, catalog, search, low-stock, and warehouse queries.

nodes.name: llm.ts
nodes.summary: Provider-agnostic LLM client for the Celestial AI feature, supporting OpenAI-compatible APIs (Groq, OpenRouter), Google Gemini, Ollama local models, and a mock fallback for development and testing.

nodes.name: completeChat
nodes.summary: Routes a chat completion request to the configured LLM provider (OpenAI-compatible, Gemini, Ollama, or mock) based on environment configuration.

nodes.name: callOpenAiCompatible
nodes.summary: Sends a chat completion request to an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (Groq, OpenRouter, etc.) and returns the text response.

nodes.name: callGemini
nodes.summary: Calls the Google Gemini API for chat completion, converting chat history format and extracting the text response.

nodes.name: mockComplete
nodes.summary: Provides a deterministic mock LLM response for development/testing by generating formatted replies based on the tool block embedded in the system prompt.

nodes.name: orchestrator.ts
nodes.summary: Central Celestial AI orchestration layer: prepares chat context by running intent-detected tools and doc retrieval, dispatches chat or streaming LLM completion, persists conversation messages, and enforces feature-flag access.

nodes.name: prepareChat
nodes.summary: Validates feature flag access, resolves buyer identity, detects intent, retrieves docs and tool results, builds the full prompt context, and optionally pre-composes a direct reply.

nodes.name: chat
nodes.summary: Executes a non-streaming Celestial AI chat turn: prepares context, completes via LLM, finalizes reply, and persists results.

nodes.name: chatStream
nodes.summary: Executes a streaming Celestial AI chat turn, emitting SSE chunks for direct compose replies or incrementally streamed LLM content, then persists the completed conversation.

nodes.name: prompts.ts
nodes.summary: Constructs system and context prompts for the Celestial AI assistant, adapting tone and capabilities based on whether the session user is a portal buyer or admin staff.

nodes.name: tools.ts
nodes.summary: Executes named ERP data-fetch tools for the Celestial AI assistant, dispatching to orders, invoices, inventory, quotes, global search, low-stock alerts, and warehouse queries to populate context for LLM responses.

nodes.name: runTool
nodes.summary: Dispatches a named tool to the appropriate ERP service (orders, invoices, inventory, quotes, search, low-stock, warehouses) and returns structured result data with navigation links.

nodes.name: compliance-msa.ts
nodes.summary: Implements MSA (Manufacturer Sales Authorization) compliance reporting: configuring tenant DID settings, importing transactions, generating weekly MULTICAT EDI files, storing them, and submitting via EDI endpoint with automated cron support.

nodes.name: generateReportForTenant
nodes.summary: Aggregates weekly MSA transactions, builds the MULTICAT EDI file, hashes and stores the file, and creates an MSA report database record.

nodes.name: submitReportEdi
nodes.summary: Retrieves a pending MSA report, reads its file from storage, and POSTs it to the configured EDI endpoint, updating the report status on success or failure.

nodes.name: runMsaAutomationCron
nodes.summary: Cron entry point that generates, uploads, and submits pending weekly MSA reports for a tenant, collecting results and errors.

nodes.name: compliance-tax.ts
nodes.summary: Provides sales tax computation utilities — calculating tax amounts from rates, resolving per-order tax based on ship-to state with tenant-configured rate fallback, and recording tax liabilities.

nodes.name: credit-limit.ts
nodes.summary: Enforces customer credit limit checks before order placement, tracks outstanding credit usage, and provides release mechanics for cancelled or paid orders.

nodes.name: crm.ts
nodes.summary: Core CRM service providing customer and lead management: CRUD and bulk import for customers and leads, Kanban-style lead status tracking, lead-to-customer conversion, and customer activity logging.

nodes.name: listCustomersPaged
nodes.summary: Returns a paginated and optionally filtered list of customers with total count for cursor-based pagination.

nodes.name: createCustomer
nodes.summary: Creates a new customer record with address, credit limit, net terms, and contact details, normalizing all string fields.

nodes.name: importLeads
nodes.summary: Bulk imports lead records from external data, validating required fields and Kanban status values, collecting per-row errors.

nodes.name: convertLead
nodes.summary: Atomically converts a CRM lead to a customer record within a transaction, updating the lead status to CONVERTED.

nodes.name: customer-notification-prefs.ts
nodes.summary: Manages per-customer notification preference settings stored as JSON on the tenant organization record, providing read, patch, and gating functions to filter notification sends by channel and template.

nodes.name: db.ts
nodes.summary: Initializes and exports all named Prisma database client instances for the platform's 14 domain databases (auth, tenant, inventory, orders, CRM, storefront, WMS, dispatch, purchasing, payments, compliance, notifications, ledger, analytics).
nodes.languageNotes: Uses separate Prisma clients per domain database, enabling independent schema evolution across ERP domains.

nodes.name: demand-planning.ts
nodes.summary: Computes SKU demand forecasts from historical stock ledger outbound events, generating days-of-supply, reorder recommendations, and suggested PO quantities for demand planning.

nodes.name: getSkuDemandPlan
nodes.summary: Computes a demand plan for a single SKU/warehouse including daily usage rate, days of supply remaining, and recommended reorder quantity based on lead time.

nodes.name: listDemandPlans
nodes.summary: Lists demand plans for all SKU/warehouse combinations, deduplicating and sorting by most critical days-of-supply to surface reorder priorities.
